entries.label: Zane rear NE candidate
entries.scope: Individual candidate or study only; not a complete asset set.
entries.qa_notes: Feet and display scale are not registered to the approved front. Pouch, scarf, coat and sword pose vary across the studies. Opposite front SW remains missing. These images are not animation and do not complete a production four-direction set.
entries.required_next_steps: Reconcile costume/accessory/weapon identity; author missing opposite front; measure per-file foot pivot and body bounds; normalize display scale; test direction changes and camera-relative facing in the exact prototype.
